mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (current value below the previous month's value) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase above 321.0 signals persistent inflation, leading to monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% and housing starts exceed 1350.0 (thousands), it indicates an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 320.0), a rising federal funds rate (current value above the previous month's value) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of instances in the monetary tightening cycle, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100.0 signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is below the 3-month moving average and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 4.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 1300.0 (thousands) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both exceed their 3-month moving averages, it indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
